payload.tension: The passage states 1 Corinthians 12:1–13 names God’s Spirit within a source unit where the Spirit speaks and is given; the wording centers attention on “I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
